source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 19 April 1924, p. 5 ("Tyrone local government: Cookstown Rural Council")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Mid-Ulster Mail's nomination list of 19 April 1924; the Stewartstown votes read in the News-Letter of 31 May 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the electoral divisions of Cookstown rural district, one member each. Ten candidates were returned unopposed; no nominations were received for Beaghmore, Killeenan, Slatequarry, Pomeroy and Killycolpy. Stewartstown was the only contest, polled on Wednesday 28 May 1924. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
